verdict.rationale: Spline's own MCP server lets AI clients drive the open editor, and the Code API can trigger actions and modify object properties in exported scenes. But there is no REST API or machine-readable spec, MCP works only through the desktop app and an open editor tab, and nothing shows it can do everything the UI can. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose editor/account API, evidence of full UI parity (file management, exports, publishing, collaboration), a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
It enables you to trigger actions, modify object properties, and create dynamic, responsive 3D environments directly from your existing code and user interface.
The MCP server is bundled in the desktop app, so connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here
